cap: Five vulvar lesions are told apart by what you see and by the biopsy. Lichen sclerosus is thin and white with dermal scarring and is treated with an ultrapotent steroid; lichen simplex chronicus is a thickened, scratched plaque with no atypia; lichen planus is erosive and reaches the vagina and mouth. Extramammary Paget disease usually has no underlying carcinoma, and condyloma comes from HPV types 6 and 11.
